shared_elements: single large upright carved stone slab/monument
standing human-like figure occupying most of the field
head with elaborated headgear/hair at top
incised bands or linear ornament crossing the body
justification: Both are tall rectangular stone surfaces dominated by a single anthropomorphic figure whose head is set at the top, with raised arms holding implements and disc/rosette motifs plus horizontal incised banding across the torso, which is a real compositional echo. But the manner is wholly different: A is a heavily eroded, dark, blocky and near-frontal image with coarse, shallow, almost schematic carving, while B is a crisp, pale, finely detailed low relief of a winged figure strictly in profile with delicate textured feathering and fringed garment.
